name: Gongbi
means: Chinese court painting: fine even outline, layered translucent mineral colour, flat gold-silk ground, meticulous stillness.
tags: gongbi, chinese painting, fine outline, mineral pigments, silk ground, meticulous, flat
prose: a gongbi painting - fine even outline with layered translucent mineral colour on a flat silk ground, meticulous
note: The counterpart to ink_wash (which measured among the strongest cards): gongbi is the meticulous coloured tradition where ink_wash is the spontaneous monochrome one. | Authored in the second wave, after the first 64 were rendered and measured. status=untested because nothing here has been rendered yet - the first wave shipped 46 cards marked ready without a single render and 27 of 64 turned out to be routed to the wrong engine.
verdict: Dark and atmospheric rather than meticulous - none of the fine even outline or flat silk ground that defines gongbi. ink_wash remains the working card in this family.
